needs_review.question_text_raw: This conference proceedings covers a variety of topics, related by a common theme: solitons and coherent structures. An objective of this paper is to exhibit some of the relations between topics, by identifying some unsolved but well-defined problems that either were or might have been discussed during the conference, and by suggesting how they might be solved using methods that were discussed here.
